why:
The criterion holds for all seven expect lines. Each one can be checked at the PR head with a single clear answer.
- Lines 1–4 are local `printf … | node bin/csv2json.js` commands with exact expected output. Their "run" proofs repeat those commands. The CRLF proof pipes the output to `od -c`, which shows every byte, so the exact output can still be confirmed.
- Line 5 is a local `node -e` import of `src/parse.js` with a fixed expected result.
- Line 6 is `npm test` plus a grep and a read of `test/csv.test.js`, all done in the repo checkout.
- Line 7 is a read of `README.md` at head.
No line needs a release, deploy, published page or anything else that only exists after merge. Publishing a release is explicitly listed as a non-goal ("Publishing a new npm release…").
